name: Mississippi

gdl.nightCurfew: Intermediate drivers may not drive 10 p.m.-6 a.m. Sun.-Thu. and 11:30 p.m.-6 a.m. Fri.-Sat., unless accompanied by a licensed parent/guardian or for work

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity/lawful presence (original birth certificate or acceptable equivalent; no photocopies)
Social Security card or official document showing full SSN
Two proofs of Mississippi residency (e.g. utility bill, bank statement)
School Attendance Form if under 18 (dated within 30 days)
process.realIdNotes: A REAL ID requires a completed application, proof of identity/lawful presence, an SSN document, and two proofs of Mississippi residency; name-change documents are required when the current name differs from the birth record.
process.permitFee: $7 (regular Class R learner's permit, valid 2 years)
process.visionStandard: Vision exam required at issuance; specific acuity threshold not published on the referenced pages

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: No point system; suspensions follow specific convictions rather than accumulated points
facts.moveOverRule: Move to a non-adjacent lane when safe, or slow down and proceed with caution, for stopped emergency and authorized vehicles with flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 15 mph when posted/flashing (varies by posted sign)

references.label: Mississippi Driver's Manual
references.citation: MS DPS Driver Service Bureau, Mississippi Driver's Manual (Jan 15, 2025 revision)

references.label: MS DPS Driver Service Fees
references.citation: MS DPS Driver Service Bureau, Driver Service Fees

verifyNote: Official DPS pages confirm fees, minimum age, required exams, and the 12-month under-17 permit period, but do not publish the written-test count/pass mark. The 30-question/24-correct format therefore remains unconfirmed; the state remains draft.
